_doc: GUARDIAN prevention matrix: leading indicators checked every run. AMBER = act before it fails (Linear priority Low/Medium, no wake); RED = failure is imminent or certain (High, wakes on P0). Each row names the failure class it predicts and the prevention action. guardian.py guard_predict implements each 'measure'.

rows.prevent: Find the grower (du at idle priority), archive to the NAS then prune regenerable data (playbook 08/16).
Stop seat-run suites; no new CI capacity; check which guest grew.

rows.red: a workflow's runs-on label has no online runner
rows.prevent: Point the workflow at a served label (jack-ci-x64) or restore the runner before jobs queue (Tentacles CI starved 14 h, 10-11 Oct).

rows.red: a live runner config still names the retired IP (config: dead_ip)
rows.prevent: Move the reference to the live IP; the retired interface is dead.

rows.amber: docker/containerd/lxd upgrade pending on Jupiter or a CI guest
rows.prevent: Hold those packages; upgrade in a drained window, never by unattended-upgrades at night.
Check ACME renewal and remove stale static certs before expiry.
Senior's crons may be starving; wake before the alarm.

rows.amber: age >= warn_h or last result not OK
rows.prevent: Run the job to its interim target; fix the target; verify a restore.

rows.amber: 1-2 seats of one lab fail with one signature
rows.prevent: Probe the lab; if it is the account, mark it OUT and broadcast before more lanes die.

rows.red: a live release path is missing from dump.pm2, or the dump points at a release with no live app (compared by pm_cwd)
rows.prevent: pm2 save after every deploy (release lane); otherwise a reboot restores an old app set (3 Oct: 0 apps; 11 Oct: sphere-api missing).

rows.red: a service start with no LOCKED line in the reviewed-start log (config: production.custody_dir) within 60 s
rows.prevent: Only ~/sphere-reviewed-start.sh restarts sphere-api (custody env + flock); plain pm2 restart --update-env dropped the custody env (outage 11 Oct 09:52-09:54).

rows.amber: an estate tool runs from a _worktrees/ or scratch path
rows.red: a wrapper's exec target is missing
rows.prevent: Estate tooling runs only from installed releases; worktrees are for development (11 Oct: deleted tentacles-computer-target worktree broke every --computer jupiter call 11:07-11:37).

rows.amber: any production listener without a supervisor
rows.red: a product port (3017/3018/3019/8000) without a supervisor
rows.prevent: Every production service runs under PM2 (and pm2 save), a systemd unit or docker; an orphan dies for good on crash or reboot.

label_exemptions.windows: win11-dev is stopped on purpose; the release captain starts it for Windows packaging (Senior, 11 Oct 08:07). Runner 22 is watched whenever the VM runs.
